title: Base case of the Gowers product
statement:
Let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be a Boolean function and let $x \in \{0,1\}^n$. With no direction vectors supplied, the order-$0$ Gowers product equals the value of $f$ at $x$:
\[
  \mathrm{GP}(f, 0, x, \emptyset) = f(x).
\]
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function f on the n-dimensional cube
base point x in the hypercube
replaced:
